# Kit component reference

*Generated by kui-addon-schema from kit's schema.lua (ADR 0066); do not edit.*

Kit: a UI kit for kui, tuned for dense tool UIs — inputs, data views, overlays, layout, charts and a trace waterfall, drawn by a skin (Ledger, Phosphor, Neutral) the host picks.

Lua places a component with `kit.<name>(props, children)` after `local kit = require("kit.ui")`; Node with `<Name … />` or `Name({ … })` from `@qxuken/kui/kit`. Props are snake_case in Lua and camelCase in Node. An event `<event>` is the prop `on_<event>` (`on<Event>`): the message it arrives as in `update`, the event's fields under `<event>`. A prop's type ending in `?` may be left out; `{T}` is a list of `T`; a colour is `0xRRGGBBAA` or a `$token`, a length px or a `$token`. Every component also takes `key` and `fresh`.

## kit.settings

Kit's look for this window: the skin, the density, the hard shadows and any role the brand overrides. Place it once a frame, before the components; it draws nothing.

Lua `kit.settings(props)` · Node `<Settings />`

| prop | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skin` | `skin` | [Skin](#skin)? | The skin; Ledger when left out. |
| `density` | `density` | [Density](#density)? | Comfortable when left out. |
| `shadows` | `shadows` | boolean? | The skin's hard shadows; on when left out. |
| `radius` | `radius` | number? | Corner radius in px, for a brand with its own; the skin's when left out. |
| `roles` | `roles` | any? | Roles the brand overrides, by name: `{ accent = 0x2f6fedff, panel = "$brandSurface" }` — a colour, `{ light, dark }` or a token each. An accent given as a colour derives the palette around it: what the skin drew in its accent takes it (the selection, a view switch's chosen segment, the first chart series and waterfall group), what it drew in the accent's hue takes the new hue, the ground and surfaces lean a few percent toward it, and every text role is moved in lightness until it reads at 4.5:1 on what it sits on (WCAG AA), what reads on the accent worked out. Roles the brand names are kept as named. |
| `appearance` | `appearance` | [Appearance](#appearance)? | Kit's colours held light or dark whatever the OS says; the OS's when left out (`system`). |
| `hair` | `hair` | number? | The hairline's width in px (rows, a field's edge); the skin's when left out. |
| `rule` | `rule` | number? | The region rule's width in px (a panel's frame, a control's border); the skin's when left out. |
| `font_ui` | `fontUi` | {string}? | The UI face, as a family list (`{ "Inter", "sans" }`); the skin's when left out. |
| `font_data` | `fontData` | {string}? | The data face (ids, numbers, code), as a family list; the skin's when left out. |

## kit.panel

A titled region: a header with the title and its actions, the body, an optional footer.

Lua `kit.panel(props, children)` · Node `<Panel />`

| prop | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `title` | string? | Its title, as the skin labels regions. |
| `subtitle` | `subtitle` | string? | A line under the title. |
| `scroll` | `scroll` | boolean? | The body scrolls rather than grows. |
| `grow` | `grow` | boolean? | Takes the room its parent leaves. |
| `pad` | `pad` | number? | The body's padding in px; 10 when left out, 0 for a body that brings its own or is often empty. |

Children:

- the list part is the body.
- `actions` goes in the header, after the title.
- `footer` goes under the body.

## kit.toolbar

A row of controls at the control height, its trailing group pushed to the far side.

Lua `kit.toolbar(props, children)` · Node `<Toolbar />`

Children:

- the list part starts it.
- `trailing` ends it, at the far side.

## kit.statusbar

A thin row at a window's foot for state: counts, the connection, the clock.

Lua `kit.statusbar(props, children)` · Node `<Statusbar />`

- `trailing` ends it, at the far side.

## kit.split

Two panes and a draggable rule between them.

Lua `kit.split(props, children)` · Node `<Split />`

| prop | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `axis` | `axis` | [Axis](#axis)? | Side by side (row, the default) or stacked. |
| `fraction` | `fraction` | number | How much of the room the first pane takes, 0 to 1: yours to keep and pass back. |
| `min` | `min` | number? | The least either pane is, in px; 80 when left out. |

|---|---|---|---|
| `on_resize` | `onResize` | `resize` = { `fraction`: number — 0 to 1. } | The rule was dragged: the fraction it asks for. |

- `second` is the second pane.

## kit.section

A heading that folds what is under it.

Lua `kit.section(props, children)` · Node `<Section />`

| prop | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `title` | string | The heading. |
| `collapsed` | `collapsed` | boolean? | Folded: yours to keep. |
| `count` | `count` | integer? | A count beside the heading. |
| `indent` | `indent` | number? | The body's left inset in px; 18 when left out, under the title. 0 for rows with their own inset that line up with `leading`. |

|---|---|---|---|
| `on_toggle` | `onToggle` | `toggle` = { `collapsed`: boolean — What it asks to be. } | The heading was pressed. |

Children:

- the list part is what it folds.
- `leading` goes before the heading, beside it rather than in it: a box that ticks the whole section.
- `actions` goes after the heading, at the far side: a status, an action on the whole section.

## kit.text_field

A one-line text field, the skin's field style (an underline in Ledger).

Lua `kit.text_field(props)` · Node `<TextField />`

| prop | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `value` | string | Its text: yours to keep, from `change`. |
| `label` | `label` | string? | Its label, above it; its name. |
| `hide_label` | `hideLabel` | boolean? | The label names the field but is not drawn: a field whose place says what it is. |
| `placeholder` | `placeholder` | string? | Shown while it is empty. |
| `mono` | `mono` | boolean? | In the data face. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | boolean? | Unavailable. |
| `width` | `width` | number? | Its width in px; grows when left out. |
| `focus` | `focus` | integer? | Takes the keyboard each time this number changes while the field is on screen: keep a counter in your model and bump it (⌘F). A field that shows after the bump takes its number as where it starts. |
| `autofocus` | `autofocus` | boolean? | Takes the keyboard as it first shows: a new item's name. |
| `error` | `error` | string? | What is wrong with the text, in the danger colour, its edge in danger too, and read after its name. It is shown whole: at the end of the field while the field has room for it beside the text, so a field in a wide toolbar keeps its height, and under the field, wrapping, while it has not, the row growing to fit. An empty string marks the field only, for fields that share one message. |
| `browse` | `browse` | [Browse](#browse)? | A Choose… button after the field that opens the system's folder, open or save dialog; the path picked arrives as `change`, as if typed. Cancelled, nothing changes. The dialog starts in the field's folder when its text is an absolute path. |
| `browse_label` | `browseLabel` | string? | The button's label; Choose… when left out. |

| event | Node | carries | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `on_change` | `onChange` | `change` = { `text`: string — The whole text. } | The text changed, or a path was picked. |
| `on_submit` | `onSubmit` | `submit` = { `text`: string — The whole text. } | Enter. |

| `grow` | `grow` | boolean? | Takes the room its parent leaves (a request body filling its tab), `rows` still its least. |

| `autofocus` | `autofocus` | boolean? | Takes the keyboard as it first shows. |

| `tab_moves_focus` | `tabMovesFocus` | boolean? | Tab and Shift+Tab move the keyboard to the next or the last control, as from a one-line field: a note, a comment. Left out, Tab types indentation as a code editor's does, and the ways out are Escape then Tab, or Ctrl+M (Ctrl+Shift+M on macOS). |

| event | Node | carries | description |

## kit.table

A virtual table over a channel: its columns, a sticky header, the rows in view only, a selection, sortable headers.

Lua `kit.table(props)` · Node `<Table />`

| prop | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `columns` | {[Column](#column)} | The columns, in order. |
| `rows` | `rows` | channel | The rows: a channel whose columns the `field`s name. |
| `selected` | `selected` | integer? | The selected row (0-based): yours to keep. |
| `selection` | `selection` | [Selection](#selection)? | What it selects: one row (the default), any rows, or none. |
| `selected_ranges` | `selectedRanges` | {[RowRange](#rowrange)}? | With `selection = "multiple"`: the selected rows, as ranges — yours to keep, from `on_select`. |
| `select_on_focus` | `selectOnFocus` | boolean? | Whether the keyboard's moves select (the default): with false the arrows move the cursor only, Space selects (toggles, in a multiple selection), Enter activates and a click selects — a detail that loads on `select` or `activate` is not loaded for every row walked past. |
| `sort` | `sort` | string? | The field it is sorted by, marked in its header; the sorting is yours. |
| `descending` | `descending` | boolean? | Sorted from the top down. |
| `striped` | `striped` | boolean? | Every other row tinted. |
| `border` | `border` | boolean? | Framed in a hairline, the header ruled off inside it; left out, no frame and the header on a plane of its own (in a panel, which is framed already). |
| `cells` | `cells` | boolean? | A table of cells: the arrows walk cells (Left and Right along a row, Up and Down keeping the column), the header a row of column headers, landing on a row selecting it. Left out, a list of rows, the arrows moving whole rows. |
| `grow` | `grow` | boolean? | Takes the room its parent leaves. |

| event | Node | carries | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `on_select` | `onSelect` | `select` = { `row`: integer — The row the change was about, 0-based: the one clicked, pressed or landed on.; `ranges`: any — A multiple selection: every selected row, as a list of `RowRange` (`{ first, last }`); absent in a single one.; `count`: integer? — A multiple selection: how many rows it holds.; `rows`: any — A multiple selection of no more than 1,000 rows: each of them, a list of integers; absent past that, and in a single one. } | The selection changed: a click, Space, the keyboard landing on a row when moves select, ⌘A, a Shift-range. One row in a single selection; in a multiple one, the ranges, their count, and the rows themselves when there are no more than 1,000. |
| `on_cursor` | `onCursor` | `cursor` = { `row`: integer — The row, 0-based. } | The row the keyboard is on moved — an arrow, a page key, a type-ahead, a click: cheap, and often. |
| `on_activate` | `onActivate` | `activate` = { `row`: integer — The row, 0-based. } | Enter on a row, or a double click: open it. Without a handler, Enter selects, as it did. |
| `on_sort` | `onSort` | `sort` = { `field`: string — The column's field. } | A header was clicked. |
| `on_range` | `onRange` | `range` = { `first`: integer — The first row in view.; `last`: integer — The last row in view. } | The rows in view changed: page your source by it. |

| `on_activate` | `onActivate` | `activate` = { `row`: integer — The row, 0-based. } | Enter on a row, or a double click: open it. Without a handler, Enter selects, as it did. |

## kit.shader

A box a fragment shader paints (a `fragment` node, ADR 0015): one of Kit's presets, WGSL handed over as `source`, or a fragment the host registered (`id`) — Kit registers the first two itself. Kit rounds the box by the skin's radius and keeps a shader that reads `time` still under reduced motion. With no shader, or one that does not compile (`fragment-rejected`), it is the skin's well.

Lua `kit.shader(props)` · Node `<Shader />`

| prop | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | `preset` | [ShaderPreset](#shaderpreset)? | One of Kit's shaders, its colours the skin's: `shimmer` (a skeleton's sweep) or `noise` (gradient noise drifting between the well and the accent). Animated unless `animate = false`. |
| `source` | `source` | string? | A WGSL `fragment` function (ADR 0015), which Kit registers: the same source, the same fragment. |
| `id` | `id` | integer? | A fragment the host registered (`Core::add_fragment`, `ctx.addFragment`, `kui_fragment_add`, `env.add_fragment`). |
| `params` | `params` | {number}? | Up to sixteen numbers the shader reads as four `vec4<f32>`; a preset's come from the skin when left out. |
| `image` | `image` | integer? | A registered image's handle, which the shader samples with `kui_sample`. |
| `animate` | `animate` | boolean? | A frame every frame, for a shader that reads `time`; off under reduced motion. |
| `width` | `width` | number? | In px; it grows when left out. |
| `height` | `height` | number? | In px; 80 when left out. |
| `grow` | `grow` | boolean? | Takes the height its parent leaves. |
| `label` | `label` | string? | What it shows, as it is read; decoration when left out. |

Lines over time with axes and a legend; `live` keeps the newest window in view.

Lua `kit.line_chart(props)` · Node `<LineChart />`

While samples come in it scrolls smoothly between them, drawn one sample behind and slid left over the time samples take to come (a keyframe cycle the core runs, so a frame between samples runs no view); under reduced motion, and while the plot is out of the viewport, it steps. |

An idle chart pays one hover layer for it. |
| `focusable` | `focusable` | boolean? | A Tab stop that is a slider over the samples: the arrows move the readout a sample, Page Up and Down ten, Home and End to the ends, and a screen reader hears the readout as its value and as a live region. No key sink: every other key, Tab and the app's chords, goes on as from any control. Left out, the chart is no Tab stop; the pointer's readout works either way. |

## Types

The enums and records the props name.

### Variant

How loud a control is; success confirms what just happened (Copied).

One of `"default"`, `"primary"`, `"ghost"`, `"danger"`, `"success"`.

### Tone

What a badge, a stat or a toast is about.

One of `"neutral"`, `"info"`, `"accent"`, `"ok"`, `"warn"`, `"danger"`.

### Align

Where a cell's content sits.

One of `"start"`, `"center"`, `"end"`.

### Axis

Which way a split divides.

One of `"row"`, `"column"`.

### Skin

The look: Ledger's paper and ink, Phosphor's terminal, or Neutral's quiet chrome.

One of `"ledger"`, `"phosphor"`, `"neutral"`.

### Density

Row and control heights: 22 and 26 px, or 20 and 22 px compact.

One of `"comfortable"`, `"compact"`.

### Level

A log line's level.

One of `"debug"`, `"info"`, `"warn"`, `"error"`.

### Browse

What a field's Choose… button asks the system for: a folder, a file to open, or where to save one.

One of `"folder"`, `"open"`, `"save"`.

### XFormat

How a chart labels its x axis: the number (with `x_unit`), time counted back to now (`-15` … `0` reads `15 min ago` … `now`), or Unix seconds as the local time of day.

One of `"number"`, `"ago"`, `"clock"`.

### Appearance

Which half of the skin's colours: the OS's, or light or dark held.

One of `"system"`, `"light"`, `"dark"`.

### ShaderPreset

One of Kit's shaders: a skeleton's shimmer, or gradient noise.

One of `"shimmer"`, `"noise"`.

### Selection

What a list or a table selects: one row, any rows (⌘- or Ctrl-click toggles a row, Shift extends from the last row clicked, ⌘A or Ctrl+A takes them all, Space toggles the row the keyboard is on), or none — the rows still a keyboard's to walk and Enter's to activate.

One of `"single"`, `"multiple"`, `"none"`.

### SkeletonShape

What a skeleton stands in for: lines of text, a block (an image, a chart), or a circle (an avatar).

One of `"text"`, `"block"`, `"circle"`.

### Choice

A choice: what it is, and what it reads as.

| field | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `value` | string | What the choice is; what the event carries. |
| `label` | `label` | string | What it reads as. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | boolean? | Shown, not choosable. |
| `count` | `count` | integer? | A count beside the label (a segment's, a tab's). |
| `alert` | `alert` | boolean? | The count is bad news: drawn in the danger colour. |

### Column

A table's column: which field of the channel it shows, and how.

| field | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `field` | `field` | string | The channel column it reads. |
| `title` | `title` | string | Its header. |
| `width` | `width` | number? | Its width in px; shares the rest when left out. |
| `min_width` | `minWidth` | number? | How narrow a sharing column goes before the table hides a column or scrolls sideways (80 when left out). |
| `priority` | `priority` | number? | How much it matters when the table is narrow: the columns that do not fit hide lowest first, the header with them; left out, it never hides. What still does not fit scrolls sideways. |
| `align` | `align` | [Align](#align)? | Where its cells sit; numbers read best at the end. |
| `mono` | `mono` | boolean? | Its cells in the data face: ids, timings, hashes. |
| `tone` | `tone` | string? | A channel column naming each cell's tone (`ok`, `warn`, `danger`, `accent`, `neutral`): the cell is drawn in it — a status, an HTTP method. |
| `badge` | `badge` | boolean? | Its cells as pills with a dot in their `tone`: a status column. |

### Tab

A tab: its value and its label.

| field | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `value` | string | What it is; what `change` carries. |
| `label` | `label` | string | What it reads as. |
| `count` | `count` | integer? | A count beside the label. |

### Item

A menu row.

| field | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `value` | string | What `choose` carries. |
| `label` | `label` | string | What it reads as. |
| `shortcut` | `shortcut` | string? | The chord beside it, as text: `⌘K`. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | boolean? | Shown, not choosable. |
| `danger` | `danger` | boolean? | A destructive action, drawn as one. |

### Check

One item of a checklist.

| field | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `label` | string | What it says; its name. |
| `checked` | `checked` | boolean | Ticked. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | boolean? | Shown, not tickable. |

### Entry

One row of an inspector: a key and its value.

| field | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `key` | string | The field's name. |
| `value` | `value` | string | Its value, as text. |
| `mono` | `mono` | boolean? | The value in the data face. |

### RowRange

Rows `first` to `last` of a list or a table, both in (0-based): a multiple selection is a list of them, so ⌘A on 100,000 rows is one.

| field | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `first` | `first` | integer | The first row in it. |
| `last` | `last` | integer | The last row in it. |

### Series

One line of a line chart.

| field | Node | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `field` | `field` | string | The channel column holding its values. |
| `name` | `name` | string | Its name in the legend. |
| `color` | `color` | color? | Its colour; the skin's series colours in order when left out. |
